endpoint.params: events[1..20]: eventId/kind/occurredAt/locale and navigationId/viewId/productSlug/path as required by each kind.
endpoint.permission: A valid analytics-consent cookie and same origin. Without consent return 403 and persist no event.

role_definitions.anonymous: No backend account session or backend role. An endpoint may still require a particular enrollment/recovery/consent credential. Such a caller remains anonymous to the backend authorization system and gets only the explicitly restricted operation.
role_definitions.visitor_session: A valid necessary chat visitor cookie. It authorizes only conversations owned by that cookie, never any backend account privilege.
role_definitions.authenticated_self: A valid current backend account/device acting on its own account. All ADMIN, SALES, and EDITOR accounts may use self-account functions; no ADMIN-only or SALES-only business authorization is implied.
role_definitions.EDITOR: A current valid backend EDITOR; public traffic/product/3D aggregates only, no shared chat or system sources.
role_definitions.SALES: A current valid backend SALES; shared human chat inbox, traffic/3D and inquiry counts under the existing sales scope. No system sources.
role_definitions.ADMIN: A current valid backend ADMIN, full authorized administration subject to fresh-grant and target restrictions.
role_definitions.cron: A controlled server job or reporting script authenticated by the dedicated Bearer CRON_SECRET. A browser session, including ADMIN, cannot substitute for that secret.
role_definitions.public: No authentication or endpoint-specific credential is required; same-origin checks and rate limiting may still apply.

contract_context: Anonymous analytics caller must carry a server-verified signed and unexpired consent cookie; no backend session is required. Server derives a domain-separated browserHash, never trusts consent=true or a browserId in the body. kinds: page_view/product_view/model_view_start/model_load_success/model_load_failure/chat_start. eventId and semanticKey are both unique with payload hashes; identical retries are duplicates and cannot recount, conflicts 409. Semantic keys bind browser hash and kind/navigation/product or viewId; one terminal result per viewId and only terminal events with a corresponding start count. Verify published product slug, sanitize path to an internal allowlisted path without query/hash, accept occurredAt only now-48h through now+5min. No IP/UA raw data, email, message body, full URLs, stack, or fingerprint.
